summary: This note is the Snowflake documentation page for the SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX.SUMMARIZE function, which summarizes a given English-language input text and returns a string summary. It covers the syntax (a single text argument), access control requiring the SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX_USER database role, and an example that summarizes the review_content column of a reviews table. It also includes legal notices that Cortex LLM functions are powered partly by Meta's LLaMA 2 model and that outputs may be inaccurate or biased and need human oversight.
one_line: Snowflake Cortex SUMMARIZE function documentation: syntax, access control, example, and legal notices for summarizing English text.
key_facts: SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX.SUMMARIZE(<text>) summarizes the given English-language input text.
The text argument is a string containing the English text from which a summary should be generated.
The function returns a string containing a summary of the original text.
Users must use a role that has been granted the SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX_USER database role to use the function.
The example queries SELECT SNOWFLAKE.CORTEX.SUMMARIZE(review_content) FROM reviews LIMIT 10;
In the example, the table named reviews contains a column named review_content holding text of reviews submitted by users.
Snowflake Cortex LLM Functions are powered by machine learning technology, including Meta's LLaMA 2.
The foundation LLaMA 2 model is licensed under the LLaMA 2 Community License.
Use of LLM Functions based on the LLaMA 2 model is subject to Meta's Acceptable Use Policy.
Machine learning technology and results provided may be inaccurate, inappropriate, or biased.
Decisions based on machine learning outputs should have human oversight and review processes to ensure model-generated content is accurate.
LLM function queries will be treated as any other SQL query and may be subject to the same handling.
Further information on safety is available in the Snowflake AI Trust and Safety FAQ.
The page lists the content language as English.
